pages.title: File:VerganeSchepen.jpg

ObjectName.value: VerganeSchepen

Categories.value: GFDL|Taken with Nikon D3|License migration redundant|Self-published work|Shipwrecks in the Netherlands

ImageDescription.value:
Ships used to sail back and forth across the tempestuous Zuider Zee from the spot where now is the province of Flevoland. Hundreds of these ships never reached their home port. Instead they sank and ended up in the muddy seabed. Sometimes they lay there for hundreds of years until they were discovered during excavation work on newly reclaimed land. More than 400 have been found, some with their cargos still on board. 
This is the wrek of a ventjager or peddler ship: This peddler ship was mainly used to transport live fish.

Artist.value: Nieuw Land
